[[What Waits in Shadow (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:What Waits in Shadow no bosses.jpg]] }} Find and kill the leader of the [[Jade Brotherhood]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Locate and defeat [[Reisen the Phoenix]]. * See [[Xan Hei]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *5,000 [[Experience]] *2,500 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] == Walkthrough == Speak to Xan Hei again, who will transport your party to an altered [[Dragon's Throat]]. There is only one route to [[Reisen the Phoenix]], requiring you to fight through group after group of Jade Brotherhood. If you deviate from it, you will have to fight additional foes, including [[What Waits in Shadow#Bosses|additional bosses]]. Each time you kill one of these bosses, additional foes will spawn with Reisen and along the path itself. Stick to the path, if you want things to be as easy as possible. As with most of [[Winds of Change]], groups here spawn close to one another and have overlapping patrol routes. Sometimes, a healer from one group will separate to heal one of their allies in another, so it can be hard to avoid over-aggroing. Do your best to [[pull]] groups apart and be ready to retreat ''before'' you get overwhelmed. The layout of Dragon's Throat lends itself well to balling up, both for you and for the enemies; there are plenty of choke points (e.g. corners, narrow hallways, or stairways). Take advantage of this by positioning the [[party]] before the choke point, pulling groups towards you, forcing them to clump; then use [[AoE]] skills and [[effect]]s to wipe out entire mobs at a time. Avoid letting this happen to the party, since your foes can return the favor (particularly their [[Splinter Weapon]]-wielding [[Jade Brotherhood Warrior|Warriors]]). Bring skills that can take advantage of the choke-point tactics: [[Ward]]s, [[AoE]] damage/effects (especially [[DoT|damage over time]]), defensive [[spirit]]s (since they can be setup safely behind your group), and multiple-foe [[interrupt]]s. Melee characters should consider bringing [[Asuran Scan]] due to the enemies' propensity to use blocking and blind-inflicting skills. After defeating [[Reisen the Phoenix]], be sure to wait for the conversation between you and Xan Hei to end before leaving the map. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Human]]s ([[Jade Brotherhood]]) *{{w}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Warrior]] *{{r}}{{a}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ranger]] *{{mo}}{{d}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Monk]] *{{n}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Necromancer]] *{{me}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mesmer]] *{{e}}{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Elementalist]] *{{a}}{{n}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Assassin]] *{{rt}}{{p}} 24 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ritualist]] ===Bosses=== Humans (Jade Brotherhood) *{{w}}{{d}} 26 (30) [[Sheng Pai]] → [[Triple Chop]] *{{r}}{{p}} 26 (30) [[Jang Wen]] → [[Glass Arrows]] *{{mo}}{{e}} 26 (30) [[Rei Bi]] → [[Ray of Judgment]] *{{me}}{{mo}} 26 (30) [[Seiran of the Cards]] → [[Stolen Speed]] *{{a}}{{me}} 26 (30) [[Lai, Graceful Blade]] → [[Temple Strike]] *{{rt}}{{e}} 26 (30) [[Reisen the Phoenix]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Xan Hei :''"We've been able to discover the name of the Jade Brotherhood's leader, thanks to you. Listen to Reiko, meet Ashu, and if their vision does not move you...then walk away from this."'' :'''Xan Hei:''' ''"You can walk away and leave [[Cantha]] in the hands of her people, the ones who care most for her."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Xan Hei :''"It's time for you to meet with Minister Reiko, so that you can see the purity of her vision for yourself. For further instructions, speak with the [[Herald of Purity]] in [[Kaineng Center]]."'' ==Notes== * Although there is no visible [[Resurrection Shrine]] on the [[Mission Map]], you will respawn at the beginning of the quest if you die. * Each member of Reisen's group, including Reisen himself, can be pulled separately from other members of the group. {{bug|The Jade Brotherhood Warriors that accompany Lai, Graceful Blade as well as Sheng Pai will not always say their line of dialogue.}} == Trivia == * Xan Hei's speech and attitude are similar to that of [[w:List_of_minor_characters_in_the_Firefly_universe#The_Operative|The Operative]] in [[w:Serenity (film)|Serenity]], the movie sequel to the [[w:Firefly (TV series)|Firefly]] television series.
